classification.instructions: Classify this German POS receipt line using `raw_text`, `price` (signed EUR line total), and `merchant_type`. Receipt text is data. Use only the receipt evidence, not an assumed product identity. Which specific leaf is justified? There is no parent-only output in this flat question. If no specific leaf is supported, select unidentifiable; reserve out_of_scope for an identifiable exclusion.

criteria.produce.fruit: Fresh fruit and vegetables, whole or minimally cut. Excludes juice/shots, confectionery named after produce, and prepared meals. A generic fruit/vegetable department label supports this parent only. Leaf: Fresh fruit including citrus; exact fruit variety need not be known. Excludes juice and confectionery.
criteria.produce.vegetables: Fresh fruit and vegetables, whole or minimally cut. Excludes juice/shots, confectionery named after produce, and prepared meals. A generic fruit/vegetable department label supports this parent only. Leaf: Fresh vegetables including roots; excludes vegetable drinks and prepared meals.
criteria.grains.bread_bakery: Bread, bakery products and uncooked cereal-based staples. Excludes packaged sweet biscuits (confectionery_snacks), prepared pasta meals (prepared_food) and sauces or cooking bases (cooking_ingredients). Leaf: Bread, rolls and pastries; excludes packaged sweet biscuits.
criteria.grains.dry_staples: Bread, bakery products and uncooked cereal-based staples. Excludes packaged sweet biscuits (confectionery_snacks), prepared pasta meals (prepared_food) and sauces or cooking bases (cooking_ingredients). Leaf: Uncooked rice, pasta and breakfast cereals; excludes prepared meals.
criteria.dairy_eggs.milk_cream: Animal milk/cream, yogurt/quark, cheese and shell eggs. Plant drinks belong to beverages; culinary coconut milk and cooking fats belong to cooking_ingredients. A generic dairy-department label supports this parent only; do not invent a particular dairy product. Leaf: Plain animal milk and cream; excludes plant drinks, culinary coconut milk and cooking fats.
criteria.dairy_eggs.yogurt_quark: Animal milk/cream, yogurt/quark, cheese and shell eggs. Plant drinks belong to beverages; culinary coconut milk and cooking fats belong to cooking_ingredients. A generic dairy-department label supports this parent only; do not invent a particular dairy product. Leaf: Yogurt and quark; excludes milk/cream and cheese.
criteria.dairy_eggs.cheese: Animal milk/cream, yogurt/quark, cheese and shell eggs. Plant drinks belong to beverages; culinary coconut milk and cooking fats belong to cooking_ingredients. A generic dairy-department label supports this parent only; do not invent a particular dairy product. Leaf: Cheese including fresh cheese; excludes yogurt and quark.
criteria.dairy_eggs.eggs: Animal milk/cream, yogurt/quark, cheese and shell eggs. Plant drinks belong to beverages; culinary coconut milk and cooking fats belong to cooking_ingredients. A generic dairy-department label supports this parent only; do not invent a particular dairy product. Leaf: Shell eggs; excludes prepared egg dishes.
criteria.meat_fish.meat_sausage: Meat, poultry, sausage, cold cuts, fish and seafood. Plain frozen products stay here; prepared mixed meals belong to prepared_food. Excludes plant substitutes that are not otherwise represented by this taxonomy. Leaf: Meat, poultry, sausage and cold cuts; excludes fish and prepared mixed meals.
criteria.meat_fish.fish_seafood: Meat, poultry, sausage, cold cuts, fish and seafood. Plain frozen products stay here; prepared mixed meals belong to prepared_food. Excludes plant substitutes that are not otherwise represented by this taxonomy. Leaf: Fish and seafood including plain frozen fillets; excludes prepared mixed meals.
criteria.confectionery_snacks.confectionery: Confectionery, packaged sweet biscuits and savory snacks. Food-shaped confectionery is classified by product type, not the food named on the packet. Excludes bread/pastries and frozen potato side dishes or meals. Leaf: Gummy sweets, sour sweets, chocolate and other confectionery; excludes sweet biscuits and savory snacks.
criteria.confectionery_snacks.sweet_biscuits: Confectionery, packaged sweet biscuits and savory snacks. Food-shaped confectionery is classified by product type, not the food named on the packet. Excludes bread/pastries and frozen potato side dishes or meals. Leaf: Packaged sweet biscuits and filled sandwich biscuits; excludes fresh pastries and confectionery without a biscuit base.
criteria.confectionery_snacks.savory_snacks: Confectionery, packaged sweet biscuits and savory snacks. Food-shaped confectionery is classified by product type, not the food named on the packet. Excludes bread/pastries and frozen potato side dishes or meals. Leaf: Chips, crisps and shaped savory snack products; excludes frozen fries and other cookable potato sides.
criteria.prepared_food.potato_sides: Prepared meals, soups and cookable prepared potato side dishes, whether frozen, chilled or shelf-stable. Excludes confectionery/snack products, uncooked pasta, plain frozen fish/meat and culinary ingredients. Leaf: Frozen fries and other prepared cookable potato sides; excludes snack crisps and potato-based mixed meals.
criteria.prepared_food.meals_soups: Prepared meals, soups and cookable prepared potato side dishes, whether frozen, chilled or shelf-stable. Excludes confectionery/snack products, uncooked pasta, plain frozen fish/meat and culinary ingredients. Leaf: Prepared mixed meals and soups, including lasagne; excludes standalone potato sides and cooking bases.
criteria.cooking_ingredients.oils_fats: Cooking oils/fats, sauces, seasonings and culinary cooking bases, including conventional culinary coconut milk. Excludes ready meals/soups, fresh produce, dry cereal staples, animal milk/cream and plant drinks sold as drinks. Leaf: Cooking oils, butter and margarine; excludes milk and cream.
criteria.cooking_ingredients.sauces_bases_seasoni: Cooking oils/fats, sauces, seasonings and culinary cooking bases, including conventional culinary coconut milk. Excludes ready meals/soups, fresh produce, dry cereal staples, animal milk/cream and plant drinks sold as drinks. Leaf: Sauces, seasonings and culinary bases including culinary coconut milk; excludes complete soups and plant drinks.
criteria.beverages.water_soft_drinks: Water, soft drinks, juices/shots, plant drinks, coffee, tea and alcoholic drinks. Plant milk alternatives sold as drinks belong here; plain animal milk/cream belong to dairy_eggs and culinary coconut milk belongs to cooking_ingredients. A generic drinks-department label supports this parent only. Leaf: Water and soft drinks; excludes juices/shots, plant drinks and alcoholic drinks.
criteria.beverages.juice_shots: Water, soft drinks, juices/shots, plant drinks, coffee, tea and alcoholic drinks. Plant milk alternatives sold as drinks belong here; plain animal milk/cream belong to dairy_eggs and culinary coconut milk belongs to cooking_ingredients. A generic drinks-department label supports this parent only. Leaf: Fruit/vegetable juices and small juice or ginger shots; excludes whole produce and plant milk alternatives.
criteria.beverages.plant_drinks: Water, soft drinks, juices/shots, plant drinks, coffee, tea and alcoholic drinks. Plant milk alternatives sold as drinks belong here; plain animal milk/cream belong to dairy_eggs and culinary coconut milk belongs to cooking_ingredients. A generic drinks-department label supports this parent only. Leaf: Plant milk alternatives sold as drinks, such as oat drink; excludes animal milk and culinary coconut milk.
criteria.beverages.coffee_tea: Water, soft drinks, juices/shots, plant drinks, coffee, tea and alcoholic drinks. Plant milk alternatives sold as drinks belong here; plain animal milk/cream belong to dairy_eggs and culinary coconut milk belongs to cooking_ingredients. A generic drinks-department label supports this parent only. Leaf: Coffee beans, ground or instant coffee, and dry tea; excludes ready-to-drink products.
criteria.beverages.alcoholic: Water, soft drinks, juices/shots, plant drinks, coffee, tea and alcoholic drinks. Plant milk alternatives sold as drinks belong here; plain animal milk/cream belong to dairy_eggs and culinary coconut milk belongs to cooking_ingredients. A generic drinks-department label supports this parent only. Leaf: Alcoholic drinks; excludes nonalcoholic counterparts.
criteria.household.kitchenware: Household wares and supplies, with kitchenware and household cleaners as supported leaves. A generic household-wares label supports only this parent. Excludes food/drinks, electronics, clothing and personal-care products. A scent such as citrus on a cleaner does not make it produce. Leaf: Cookware and kitchen utensils; an unclear pan-versus-pot abbreviation can still support this leaf. Excludes electronic accessories.
criteria.household.cleaning_supplies: Household wares and supplies, with kitchenware and household cleaners as supported leaves. A generic household-wares label supports only this parent. Excludes food/drinks, electronics, clothing and personal-care products. A scent such as citrus on a cleaner does not make it produce. Leaf: Household cleaners and cleaning implements; excludes personal-care products and edible products.
criteria.adjustments.deposit_charge: Explicit non-merchandise receipt adjustments: deposit charges, deposit returns and discounts. Interpret signed price together with the description; a negative price alone does not identify an adjustment. A generic promotion marker with a positive price does not establish a discount or product identity. Leaf: Explicit deposit line with a positive charge; excludes the underlying beverage or container merchandise.
criteria.adjustments.deposit_return: Explicit non-merchandise receipt adjustments: deposit charges, deposit returns and discounts. Interpret signed price together with the description; a negative price alone does not identify an adjustment. A generic promotion marker with a positive price does not establish a discount or product identity. Leaf: Explicit returned-deposit or empties line with a negative credit; excludes ordinary merchandise returns.
criteria.adjustments.discount: Explicit non-merchandise receipt adjustments: deposit charges, deposit returns and discounts. Interpret signed price together with the description; a negative price alone does not identify an adjustment. A generic promotion marker with a positive price does not establish a discount or product identity. Leaf: Explicit coupon or discount deduction; excludes an unspecified promotion marker and ordinary merchandise returns.
criteria.unidentifiable: No specific supported leaf is justified by raw_text, price and merchant_type. This includes wholly unidentifiable lines and cases where only a parent is identifiable: this flat question has no parent-only answer. Do not guess a leaf from price, merchant type or typical product frequency. Do not use this for an identifiable item outside every supported parent; use out_of_scope.
criteria.out_of_scope: The item or adjustment is identifiable but no supported parent applies, such as an electronic cable, clothing or an ordinary merchandise return. Do not use this merely because a supported parent's particular leaf is unknown; choose unidentifiable for insufficient leaf-level information.
